---
title: "CFP Finder – AI Agent"
subtitle: "AI-Powered Search for Calls for Papers, Special Issues & Conferences"
---

::: {.callout-tip}
### How It Works

This agent uses **Google Gemini** (free tier) with **live web search** to find open CFPs relevant to our research.
Paste your free API key from [aistudio.google.com/apikey](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey){target="_blank"} — it stays in your browser only, nothing is stored.
:::

```{=html}
<style>
  /* ===== Chat shell — sits inside the Quarto page layout ===== */
  .cfp-chat-shell {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    height: 70vh; min-height: 480px;
    border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #333);
    border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--bs-body-bg, #222);
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }

  /* ===== Key bar ===== */
  .cfp-key-bar {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #333);
    background: rgba(0,0,0,.15);
  }
  .cfp-key-bar input {
    background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #444);
    color: var(--bs-body-color, #ddd); border-radius: 6px;
    font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px; padding: 5px 10px;
    width: 240px; outline: none;
  }
  .cfp-key-bar input:focus { border-color: #003d7a; }
  .cfp-key-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .cfp-key-dot.off { background: #dc3545; }
  .cfp-key-dot.on  { background: #28a745; box-shadow: 0 0 6px #28a74560; }
  .cfp-key-link { font-size: 11px; color: #4a90e2; text-decoration: none; }
  .cfp-key-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

  /* ===== Quick-topic chips ===== */
  .cfp-topics { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #333); }
  .cfp-topic-chip {
    padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
    border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #444);
    background: transparent; color: var(--bs-body-color, #bbb);
    cursor: pointer; transition: all .2s;
  }
  .cfp-topic-chip:hover { border-color: #003d7a; color: #4a90e2; }

  /* ===== Chat messages ===== */
  .cfp-chat-area {
    flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 20px 16px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px;
  }
  .cfp-msg { display: flex; gap: 10px; animation: cfpFadeIn .3s ease; }
  .cfp-msg.user { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
  @keyframes cfpFadeIn { from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} }

  .cfp-avatar {
    width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 8px; flex-shrink: 0;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 15px;
  }
  .cfp-msg.bot .cfp-avatar { background: #003d7a; }
  .cfp-msg.user .cfp-avatar { background: #ff6b35; }

  .cfp-bubble {
    padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 12px; max-width: 85%;
    font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; word-wrap: break-word;
  }
  .cfp-msg.bot .cfp-bubble {
    background: rgba(0,61,122,.12); border: 1px solid rgba(0,61,122,.25);
    border-top-left-radius: 3px;
  }
  .cfp-msg.user .cfp-bubble {
    background: rgba(255,107,53,.15); border: 1px solid rgba(255,107,53,.25);
    border-top-right-radius: 3px;
  }
  .cfp-bubble a { color: #4a90e2; }
  .cfp-bubble strong { color: var(--bs-body-color, #eee); }

  /* Grounding source chips */
  .cfp-sources { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; margin-top: 8px; }
  .cfp-src-chip {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px;
    padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 11px;
    background: rgba(0,61,122,.1); border: 1px solid rgba(0,61,122,.2);
    color: #4a90e2; text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s;
  }
  .cfp-src-chip:hover { background: rgba(0,61,122,.2); }

  /* Typing dots */
  .cfp-typing { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 6px 0; }
  .cfp-typing span {
    width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #666;
    animation: cfpBlink 1.4s infinite both;
  }
  .cfp-typing span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay:.2s; }
  .cfp-typing span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay:.4s; }
  @keyframes cfpBlink { 0%,80%,100%{opacity:.3} 40%{opacity:1} }

  /* Welcome screen */
  .cfp-welcome { text-align:center; padding: 30px 16px; flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:12px; }
  .cfp-welcome h3 { margin:0; font-size:20px; }
  .cfp-welcome p { color: var(--bs-secondary-color, #999); font-size:13px; margin:0; max-width:460px; }
  .cfp-example-btn {
    padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px;
    border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #444);
    background: transparent; color: var(--bs-body-color, #bbb);
    cursor: pointer; transition: all .2s; text-align: left; width: 100%; max-width: 460px;
  }
  .cfp-example-btn:hover { border-color: #003d7a; color: #4a90e2; }

  /* ===== Input bar ===== */
  .cfp-input-bar {
    display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #333);
    background: rgba(0,0,0,.1);
  }
  .cfp-input-bar textarea {
    flex: 1; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #444);
    background: transparent; color: var(--bs-body-color, #ddd);
    font-size: 14px; outline: none; resize: none;
    min-height: 40px; max-height: 100px;
  }
  .cfp-input-bar textarea:focus { border-color: #003d7a; }
  .cfp-send-btn {
    width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 8px; border: none;
    background: #003d7a; color: #fff; font-size: 16px;
    cursor: pointer; transition: all .2s; flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .cfp-send-btn:hover { background: #00509e; }
  .cfp-send-btn:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }

  .cfp-footer { text-align:center; font-size:11px; color:#777; padding: 6px; }
  .cfp-footer a { color: #4a90e2; }
</style>

<!-- ===== APP SHELL ===== -->
<div class="cfp-chat-shell">

  <!-- Key bar -->
  <div class="cfp-key-bar">
    <span class="cfp-key-dot off" id="kDot"></span>
    <input type="password" id="gKey" placeholder="Paste Gemini API key..." oninput="cfpCheckKey()" autocomplete="off">
    <a class="cfp-key-link" href="https://aistudio.google.com/apikey" target="_blank">Get free key &#8599;</a>
  </div>

  <!-- Quick topics -->
  <div class="cfp-topics">
    <button class="cfp-topic-chip" onclick="cfpAskTopic('GAMLSS MSGARCH volatility regime switching')">&#128202; GAMLSS / MSGARCH</button>
    <button class="cfp-topic-chip" onclick="cfpAskTopic('multi-objective portfolio optimization NSGA-II evolutionary')">&#127919; Multi-Obj. Optimization</button>
    <button class="cfp-topic-chip" onclick="cfpAskTopic('reinforcement learning finance portfolio Q-learning')">&#129302; RL in Finance</button>
    <button class="cfp-topic-chip" onclick="cfpAskTopic('agricultural commodity markets futures grain')">&#127806; Commodities</button>
    <button class="cfp-topic-chip" onclick="cfpAskTopic('financial econometrics GARCH Bayesian time series')">&#128200; Econometrics</button>
    <button class="cfp-topic-chip" onclick="cfpAskTopic('computational intelligence metaheuristic optimization')">&#9889; Comp. Intelligence</button>
  </div>

  <!-- Chat area -->
  <div class="cfp-chat-area" id="cfpChat">
    <div class="cfp-welcome" id="cfpWelcome">
      <div style="font-size:40px">&#128300;</div>
      <h3>CFP Research Agent</h3>
      <p>I search the web in real time for open calls for papers, special issues, conferences, and journal opportunities relevant to PAIC research. Ask me anything!</p>
      <button class="cfp-example-btn" onclick="cfpAskEx(this)">&#128269; Find open CFPs for multi-objective portfolio optimization with evolutionary algorithms</button>
      <button class="cfp-example-btn" onclick="cfpAskEx(this)">&#128197; What IEEE conferences in 2026 accept papers on computational intelligence in finance?</button>
      <button class="cfp-example-btn" onclick="cfpAskEx(this)">&#128240; Are there any special issues on GARCH, regime switching, or volatility modeling open now?</button>
      <button class="cfp-example-btn" onclick="cfpAskEx(this)">&#127806; Find journal CFPs related to agricultural commodity risk management and futures markets</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Input -->
  <div class="cfp-input-bar">
    <textarea id="cfpInput" rows="1" placeholder="Ask about calls for papers, deadlines, conferences..."
              onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'&&!event.shiftKey){event.preventDefault();cfpSend()}"
              oninput="this.style.height='auto';this.style.height=Math.min(this.scrollHeight,100)+'px'"></textarea>
    <button class="cfp-send-btn" id="cfpSendBtn" onclick="cfpSend()" disabled>&#10148;</button>
  </div>

  <div class="cfp-footer">
    Powered by <a href="https://ai.google.dev" target="_blank">Google Gemini</a> with live web search &#8226; 100% client-side &#8226; No data stored
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";
  var hist=[], busy=false;

  var SYS = [
    "You are an expert academic research assistant specialized in finding open Calls for Papers (CFPs).",
    "Your primary task is to search the web and find currently open or upcoming CFPs, special issues,",
    "conference submissions, and journal submission opportunities.",
    "",
    "The user is part of PAIC Econometrics at FAE Business School, researching:",
    "- GAMLSS and MSGARCH models for volatility and distributional analysis of agricultural commodity returns",
    "- Multi-objective portfolio optimization using evolutionary algorithms (NSGA-II, DEoptim)",
    "- Reinforcement Learning (Q-Learning, K-Bandit) for dynamic multi-period portfolio allocation",
    "- Agricultural commodity markets (corn, soybean, wheat futures)",
    "- Financial econometrics, regime switching, Bayesian methods",
    "",
    "For each CFP found, provide: **Name**, **Type** (journal/conference/workshop/special issue),",
    "**Deadline**, **URL**, and a brief description. Search IEEE (CEC, WCCI, SSCI), ACM, INFORMS,",
    "Elsevier (EJOR, Expert Systems), Springer, MDPI, Wiley, Taylor & Francis, and specialized venues.",
    "Prioritize opportunities with upcoming deadlines in 2025-2026. Always include URLs.",
    "Respond in English."
  ].join("\n");

  function $(id){return document.getElementById(id)}

  window.cfpCheckKey=function(){
    var k=$("gKey").value.trim();
    $("kDot").className="cfp-key-dot "+(k.length>10?"on":"off");
    $("cfpSendBtn").disabled=k.length<=10;
  };

  function addMsg(role,html,sources){
    var w=$("cfpWelcome"); if(w) w.style.display="none";
    var area=$("cfpChat"), d=document.createElement("div");
    d.className="cfp-msg "+role;
    var av='<div class="cfp-avatar">'+(role==="user"?"&#128100;":"&#129302;")+'</div>';
    var src="";
    if(sources&&sources.length){
      src='<div class="cfp-sources">';
      sources.forEach(function(s){
        var dom=""; try{dom=new URL(s.uri).hostname.replace("www.","")}catch(e){dom=s.uri}
        src+='<a class="cfp-src-chip" href="'+s.uri+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">&#128279; '+(s.title||dom)+'</a>';
      });
      src+='</div>';
    }
    d.innerHTML=av+'<div class="cfp-bubble">'+html+src+'</div>';
    area.appendChild(d); area.scrollTop=area.scrollHeight;
  }

  function addTyping(){
    var d=document.createElement("div"); d.className="cfp-msg bot"; d.id="cfpTyping";
    d.innerHTML='<div class="cfp-avatar">&#129302;</div><div class="cfp-bubble"><div class="cfp-typing"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div></div>';
    $("cfpChat").appendChild(d); $("cfpChat").scrollTop=$("cfpChat").scrollHeight;
  }

  function renderMd(t){
    return t
      .replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g,'<strong>$1</strong>')
      .replace(/\*(.+?)\*/g,'<em>$1</em>')
      .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g,'<code>$1</code>')
      .replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\((https?:\/\/[^\)]+)\)/g,'<a href="$2" target="_blank">$1</a>')
      .replace(/(^|[\s(])(https?:\/\/[^\s)<]+)/g,'$1<a href="$2" target="_blank">$2</a>')
      .replace(/\n/g,'<br>');
  }

  window.cfpSend=function(){
    if(busy) return;
    var key=$("gKey").value.trim(), inp=$("cfpInput"), txt=inp.value.trim();
    if(!txt||!key) return;
    inp.value=""; inp.style.height="auto";
    addMsg("user", txt.replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;"));
    hist.push({role:"user",parts:[{text:txt}]});
    busy=true; $("cfpSendBtn").disabled=true; addTyping();

    fetch("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash:generateContent?key="+key,{
      method:"POST", headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},
      body:JSON.stringify({
        system_instruction:{parts:[{text:SYS}]},
        contents:hist,
        tools:[{google_search:{}}],
        generationConfig:{temperature:0.7,maxOutputTokens:4096}
      })
    })
    .then(function(r){ return r.ok ? r.json() : r.json().then(function(e){throw new Error(e.error?e.error.message:"API error")}); })
    .then(function(res){
      var el=$("cfpTyping"); if(el) el.remove();
      busy=false; $("cfpSendBtn").disabled=false;
      var txt="", src=[];
      if(res.candidates&&res.candidates[0]){
        var c=res.candidates[0];
        if(c.content&&c.content.parts) c.content.parts.forEach(function(p){if(p.text) txt+=p.text;});
        if(c.groundingMetadata&&c.groundingMetadata.groundingChunks)
          c.groundingMetadata.groundingChunks.forEach(function(ch){if(ch.web) src.push({uri:ch.web.uri,title:ch.web.title||""});});
      }
      if(!txt) txt="No response received. Please try again.";
      hist.push({role:"model",parts:[{text:txt}]});
      addMsg("bot",renderMd(txt),src);
    })
    .catch(function(err){
      var el=$("cfpTyping"); if(el) el.remove();
      busy=false; $("cfpSendBtn").disabled=false;
      addMsg("bot",'<strong style="color:#dc3545">Error:</strong> '+(err.message||err)+
        '<br><br>Check your Gemini API key. <a href="https://aistudio.google.com/apikey" target="_blank">Get a free key here</a>.');
    });
  };

  window.cfpAskTopic=function(kw){ $("cfpInput").value="Find open calls for papers related to: "+kw; cfpSend(); };
  window.cfpAskEx=function(btn){ $("cfpInput").value=(btn.textContent||btn.innerText).replace(/^[\s\S]?\s/,"").trim(); cfpSend(); };
})();
</script>
```
